The structure of Dy6Cu4Sn2 (Dy3Cu2Sn) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Cu, Dy, and Sn centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; Dy centers have 9 Cu and 3 Sn neighbors, Cu centers 3 Cu and 9 Dy, and Sn centers 3 Cu and 9 Dy, all near 3.03–3.10 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include Dy–Dy and Cu–Sn 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Dy–Dy pairs sharing corners and edges.
